# 能带与验证视图 / Bands and verification

蓝色能带来自已保存的 QE XML 数值本征值。绿色区间来自对应源的有限点谱证书，表示切口之间没有谱且窗下态数已接收；它们不是每条数值能带的严格误差条。绘图不会把记录点插值成已验证的连续能带面。

公共 C、H₂ 和 Si 示例沿用已发布计算；本次只解析结果、转换显示单位并绘图，没有新运行 QE 或重放大型数学证明。用户的 PAW 输入和能带保留在本地，不包含在公共示例中。

The plotted eigenvalues are numerical. Received finite-point spectral windows concern complete recorded finite plane-wave carriers, rather than an interval enclosure of every plotted eigenvalue. The Si reference-model SCF receipt is reported separately. Sampled band-index separations are not a continuous-Brillouin-zone gap or a metal/insulator classification.

The offline desktop report embeds the same viewer with its local data. Reading a saved receipt is distinct from replaying the mathematical receiver. Uploaded or imported numerical files do not acquire a certificate merely by being plotted.
